_meta.purpose: Frozen 72-case semantic release corpus for scripts/eval_interpreter.py and model selection. Covers all six directive types, paraphrases, time boundaries, percentages/fractions, capacity-relative reserves, negation, tentative language, distractors, and prompt-injection attempts. Labels must be reviewed independently before any prompt tuning.
